description: Type text into an input field by snapshot ref, element index or CSS selector.

clear.description: true replaces the field content, false appends to it (default: replace).

index.description: The numeric index of the input element from the snapshot (mapped to ref "@e<index>").

ref.description: Element reference from browser_snapshot (e.g. "@e12"). Preferred over index; also used to target a scroll container.

selector.description: Alternative CSS selector of the input element.

tabId.description: Optional browser tab id to act on instead of the focused tab.

text.description: The text to type into the field.

name: browser_type
